lace_with_bloodrot.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次箭矢攻击获得+3力量，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，在其控制下创造一个血腐疫病衍生物。”
再动
lace_with_bloodrot.text_en:
Your next arrow attack this turn gains +3{p} and "When this hits a hero, create a Bloodrot Pox token under their control."
Go again

lace_with_frailty.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次箭矢攻击获得+3力量，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，在其控制下创造一个虚弱衍生物。”
再动
lace_with_frailty.text_en:
Your next arrow attack this turn gains +3{p} and "When this hits a hero, create a Frailty token under their control."
Go again

lace_with_inertia.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次箭矢攻击获得+3力量，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，在其控制下创造一个惰性衍生物。”
再动
lace_with_inertia.text_en:
Your next arrow attack this turn gains +3{p} and "When this hits a hero, create an Inertia token under their control."
Go again

laced_lightning.text_zh: 瞬间——支付2点资源，摧毁此牌：防止本回合接下来将对你造成的1点伤害。若你以此方式防止伤害，创造一个闪电化身衍生物。
laced_lightning.text_en: Instant - {r}{r}, destroy this: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to you this turn. If you prevent damage this way, create an Embodiment of Lightning token.

laden_with_earth.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次攻击获得+3力量。
大地羁绊——若你为使用此牌资源过一张大地牌，创造一个大地化身衍生物。
再动
laden_with_earth.text_en:
Your next attack this turn gets +3{p}.
Earth Bond - If an Earth card was pitched to play this, create an Embodiment of Earth token.
Go again

laden_with_frost.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次攻击获得+3力量。
冰羁绊——若你为使用此牌资源过一张冰牌，在目标英雄的控制下创造一个霜咬衍生物。
再动
laden_with_frost.text_en:
Your next attack this turn gets +3{p}.
Ice Bond - If an Ice card was pitched to play this, create a Frostbite token under target hero's control.
Go again

laden_with_lightning.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次攻击获得+3力量。
闪电羁绊——若你为使用此牌资源过一张闪电牌，创造一个闪电化身衍生物。
再动
laden_with_lightning.text_en:
Your next attack this turn gets +3{p}.
Lightning Bond - If a Lightning card was pitched to play this, create an Embodiment of Lightning token.
Go again

lady_barthimont.text_zh:
当巴希蒙特牌面朝下在军械库中时，在你的回合开始时，你可以将她翻为正面朝上。
当巴希蒙特正面朝上在军械库中时，每当你使用攻击行动牌时，放逐你牌库顶的一张牌。若被放逐的牌力量为6或更高，该攻击获得支配，并在巴希蒙特上放置一个课业指示物。然后若她上有2个或更多课业指示物，放逐她，从你的牌库中搜寻一张专精牌，将其正面朝上放入军械库，然后洗牌。
lady_barthimont.text_en:
While Barthimont is face down in arsenal, at the start of your turn, you may turn her face up.
While Barthimont is face up in arsenal, whenever you play an attack action card, banish the top card of your deck. If the banished card has 6 or more {p}, the attack gains dominate and put a lesson counter on Barthimont. Then if there are 2 or more lesson counters on her, banish her, search your deck for a specialization card, put it face up into arsenal, and shuffle.

lair_of_the_spider.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 行动 防御反应·陷阱
lair_of_the_spider.text_zh: 当此牌防御具有再动的攻击时，标记攻击英雄。
lair_of_the_spider.text_en: When this defends an attack with go again, mark the attacking hero.

last_ditch_effort.text_zh: 当你使用最后挣扎时，若你的牌库中没有牌，它获得+4力量和再动。
last_ditch_effort.text_en: When you play Last Ditch Effort, if you have no cards in your deck, it gains +4{p} and go again.

laughing_knee_slappers.type_zh: 憎恶 蛮将 装备·腿部
laughing_knee_slappers.text_zh:
若你控制一个力量和一个活力衍生物，此牌获得+2防御。
刃碎
laughing_knee_slappers.text_en:
If you control a Might and a Vigor token, this gets +2{d}.
Blade Break

lava_burst.text_zh: 破裂——若熔岩爆发是作为链环4或更高使用的，它获得+3力量。
lava_burst.text_en: Rupture - If Lava Burst is played as chain link 4 or higher, it has +3{p}.

lava_vein_loyalty.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击
lava_vein_loyalty.text_zh: 若你控制2个或更多龙裔链环，此牌获得再动。
lava_vein_loyalty.text_en: If you control 2 or more Draconic chain links, this gets go again.

lay_down_the_challenge.text_zh:
威吓目标英雄，然后若其手牌比你多，抽一张牌。
再动
lay_down_the_challenge.text_en:
Intimidate target hero, then if they have more cards in hand than you, draw a card.
Go again

lay_down_the_law.text_zh: 塔盾——若此牌的力量为13或更高，当防御此牌时，非装备牌获得-1防御。
lay_down_the_law.text_en: Tower - If this has 13 or more {p}, non-equipment cards get -1{d} while defending this.

lay_low.text_zh:
若你已被标记，你不能使用此牌。
若防御英雄已被标记，其本回合的下一次攻击获得-1力量。
lay_low.text_en:
If you are marked, you can't play this.
If the defending hero is marked, their next attack this turn gets -1{p}.

lay_to_rest.text_zh:
当此牌攻击暗影英雄时，它获得+1力量。
当此牌命中英雄时，你可以将其放逐区中的一张牌翻为牌面朝下。
lay_to_rest.text_en:
When this attacks a Shadow hero, it gets +1{p}.
When this hits a hero, you may turn a card in their banished zone face-down.

lay_waste.text_zh:
推进
此牌不能被装备防御。
lay_waste.text_en:
Boost
This can't be defended by equipment.

lead_the_charge.text_zh:
本回合你下一次使用费用为0或更高的行动牌时，获得1个行动点。
再动
lead_the_charge.text_en:
The next time you play an action card with cost 0 or greater this turn, gain 1 action point.
Go again

lead_with_heart.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次守护者或战士攻击获得+3力量。
创造一个活力衍生物。
再动
lead_with_heart.text_en:
Your next Guardian or Warrior attack this turn gets +3{p}.
Create a Vigor token.
Go again

lead_with_power.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次蛮将或守护者攻击获得+3力量。
创造一个力量衍生物。
再动
lead_with_power.text_en:
Your next Brute or Guardian attack this turn gets +3{p}.
Create a Might token.
Go again

lead_with_speed.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次蛮将或战士攻击获得+3力量。
创造一个敏捷衍生物。
再动
lead_with_speed.text_en:
Your next Brute or Warrior attack this turn gets +3{p}.
Create an Agility token.
Go again

leap_frog_gloves.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 装备·手臂
leap_frog_gloves.text_zh:
当对手使用或启动攻击反应时，你可以将此牌作为防御牌加入当前链环。
刃碎
leap_frog_gloves.text_en:
When an opponent plays or activates an attack reaction, you may add this to the active chain link as a defending card.
Blade Break

leap_frog_leggings.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 装备·腿部
leap_frog_leggings.text_zh:
当对手使用或启动攻击反应时，你可以将此牌作为防御牌加入当前链环。
刃碎
leap_frog_leggings.text_en:
When an opponent plays or activates an attack reaction, you may add this to the active chain link as a defending card.
Blade Break

leap_frog_slime_skin.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 装备·胸部
leap_frog_slime_skin.text_zh:
当对手使用或启动攻击反应时，你可以将此牌作为防御牌加入当前链环。
刃碎
leap_frog_slime_skin.text_en:
When an opponent plays or activates an attack reaction, you may add this to the active chain link as a defending card.
Blade Break

leap_frog_vocal_sac.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 装备·头部
leap_frog_vocal_sac.text_zh:
当对手使用或启动攻击反应时，你可以将此牌作为防御牌加入当前链环。
刃碎
leap_frog_vocal_sac.text_en:
When an opponent plays or activates an attack reaction, you may add this to the active chain link as a defending card.
Blade Break

leave_a_dent.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次守护者攻击获得“粉碎——当此牌对英雄造成4点或更多伤害时，摧毁其牌库顶的4张牌。”
再动
leave_a_dent.text_en:
Your next Guardian attack this turn gets "Crush - When this deals 4 or more damage to a hero, destroy the top 4 cards of their deck."
Go again

leave_em_speechless.text_zh:
若你的生命高于其他每位英雄，你可以将此牌当作瞬间使用。
当此牌进入竞技场时，说出一张牌名。当此牌在竞技场中时，被说出的牌不能从手牌使用。
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁此牌。
leave_em_speechless.text_en:
If you have more {h} than each other hero, you may play this as though it were an instant.
When this enters the arena, name a card. The named card can't be played from hand while this is in the arena.
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this.

leave_no_witnesses.text_zh:
契约——你受契约束缚以放逐对手的红色牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌和其军械库中的至多1张牌。
leave_no_witnesses.text_en:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' red cards. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck and up to 1 card in their arsenal.

leave_them_hanging.type_zh: 憎恶 守护者 瞬间·光环
leave_them_hanging.text_zh:
悬念
当此牌进入或离开竞技场时，威吓目标英雄。
当此牌离开竞技场时，你本回合的下一次攻击获得+4力量。
leave_them_hanging.text_en:
Suspense
When this enters or leaves the arena, intimidate target hero.
When this leaves the arena, your next attack this turn gets +4{p}.

leaven_sheath.text_zh: 大地羁绊——若你为使用此牌资源过一张大地牌，创造一个大地化身衍生物。
leaven_sheath.text_en: Earth Bond - If an Earth card was pitched to play this, create an Embodiment of Earth token.

leech_memory.text_zh:
本回合你使用的下一张攻击行动牌获得+3力量，以及“每当此牌对英雄造成伤害时，你可以将你坟场中的一张攻击行动牌置于你的牌库底。”
再动
leech_memory.text_en:
The next attack action card you play this turn gets +3{p} and "Whenever this deals damage to a hero, you may put an attack action card from your graveyard on the bottom of your deck."
Go again

leech_renown.text_zh:
本回合你使用的下一张攻击行动牌获得+3力量，以及“每当此牌对英雄造成伤害时，摧毁其控制的一个光环衍生物。”
再动
leech_renown.text_en:
The next attack action card you play this turn gets +3{p} and "Whenever this deals damage to a hero, destroy an aura token they control."
Go again

leech_vitality.text_zh:
本回合你使用的下一张攻击行动牌获得+3力量，以及“每当此牌对英雄造成伤害时，获得1点生命。”
再动
leech_vitality.text_en:
The next attack action card you play this turn gets +3{p} and "Whenever this deals damage to a hero, gain 1{h}."
Go again

legacy_of_ikaru.text_zh: 目标忍者攻击获得+1力量，以及“当此牌命中时，若秋之刃是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，抽一张牌。”
legacy_of_ikaru.text_en: Target Ninja attack gets +1{p} and "When this hits, if Edge of Autumn was the last attack this combat chain, draw a card."

lesson_in_lava.text_zh:
卡诺专精
对目标对手英雄造成3点秘法伤害。
若熔岩之课造成伤害，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张费用小于或等于熔岩之课造成的伤害的法师牌，展示它，然后洗牌并将其置于你的牌库顶。
lesson_in_lava.text_en:
Kano Specialization
Deal 3 arcane damage to target opposing hero.
If Lesson in Lava deals damage, you may search your deck for a Wizard card with {r} cost equal to or less than the damage dealt by Lesson in Lava, reveal it, then shuffle your deck and put it on top of your deck.

lessons_learned.text_zh: 将你坟场中至多3张不同名称的攻击反应牌洗入你的牌库。
lessons_learned.text_en: Shuffle up to 3 attack reaction cards with different names from your graveyard into your deck.

let_me_buy_you_a_drink.name_en: Let Me Buy You a Drink
let_me_buy_you_a_drink.text_zh:
摧毁你控制的一个金币。
选择一位对手。该英雄抽一张牌。直到你的下一个回合开始，该英雄控制的以你为目标的攻击获得-2力量。
let_me_buy_you_a_drink.text_en:
Destroy a Gold you control.
Choose an opponent. They draw a card. Until the start of your next turn, attacks they control that target you get -2{p}.

levels_of_enlightenment.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，为本回合你资源过的每张蓝色牌选择其一；
- 抽一张牌。
- 此牌获得+2力量。
- 此牌获得再动。
levels_of_enlightenment.text_en:
When this attacks, choose 1 for each blue card you've pitched this turn;
- Draw a card.
- This gets +2{p}.
- This gets go again.

levia.text_zh: 若本回合有一张力量为6或更高的牌被置入你的放逐区，在结束阶段期间你拥有的牌失去血债。
levia.text_en: If a card with 6 or more {p} has been put into your banished zone this turn, cards you own lose blood debt during the end phase.

levia_redeemed.text_zh:
传奇莱维娅专精
行动——将你放逐区中的所有牌翻为牌面朝下：转化为被救赎的莱维娅。仅当此牌在你物品栏中且你放逐区中有13张或更多具有血债的牌时才能启动此异能。
你拥有的牌失去血债。
levia_redeemed.text_en:
Legendary Levia Specialization
Action - Turn all cards in your banished zone face-down: Transform into Levia, Redeemed. Activate this ability only while this is in your inventory and you have 13 or more cards with blood debt in your banished zone.
Cards you own lose blood debt.

levia_shadowborn_abomination.name_zh: 莱维娅·暗影所生之孽物
levia_shadowborn_abomination.type_zh: 暗影 蛮将 英雄
levia_shadowborn_abomination.text_zh: 若本回合有一张力量为6或更高的牌被置入你的放逐区，在结束阶段期间你拥有的牌失去血债。
levia_shadowborn_abomination.text_en: If a card with 6 or more {p} has been put into your banished zone this turn, cards you own lose blood debt during the end phase.

lexi.text_zh:
冰与闪电精华
每回合一次行动——将你军械库中的一张牌面朝下的牌翻为正面朝上：若其为闪电牌，你本回合的下一次攻击获得再动。若其为冰牌，在目标英雄的控制下创造一个霜咬衍生物。再动
lexi.text_en:
Essence of Ice and Lightning
Once per Turn Action - Turn a face down card in your arsenal face up: If it's a Lightning card, your next attack this turn gains go again. If it's an Ice card, create a Frostbite token under target hero's control. Go again

lexi_livewire.type_zh: 元素 游侠 英雄
lexi_livewire.text_zh:
冰与闪电精华
每回合一次行动——将你军械库中的一张牌面朝下的牌翻为正面朝上：若其为闪电牌，你本回合的下一次攻击获得再动。若其为冰牌，在目标英雄的控制下创造一个霜咬衍生物。再动
lexi_livewire.text_en:
Essence of Ice and Lightning
Once per Turn Action - Turn a face down card in your arsenal face up: If it's a Lightning card, your next attack this turn gains go again. If it's an Ice card, create a Frostbite token under target hero's control. Go again

ley_line_of_the_old_ones.name_en: Ley Line of the Old Ones
ley_line_of_the_old_ones.text_zh:
传奇
当此牌进入竞技场时以及每当你造成伤害时，创造一个地震涌动衍生物。在你的结束阶段开始时，若你没有控制地震涌动衍生物，摧毁此牌。
ley_line_of_the_old_ones.text_en:
Legendary
When this enters the arena and whenever you deal damage, create a Seismic Surge token. At the beginning of your end phase, if you control no Seismic Surge tokens, destroy this.

liars_charm.type_zh: 憎恶 守护者 瞬间
liars_charm.text_zh:
选择任意数量；
- 偷取一个坚韧或活力衍生物。
- 观众为你喝倒彩。
- 目标英雄在本行动阶段失去且不能获得异能，除非其弃一张牌。
liars_charm.text_en:
Choose any number;
- Steal a Toughness or Vigor token.
- The crowd boos you.
- Target hero loses and can't gain abilities this action phase unless they discard a card.

life_for_a_life.text_zh:
当此牌被使用时，若你的生命低于一位对手英雄，它获得再动。
当此牌命中时，获得1点生命。
life_for_a_life.text_en:
When this is played, if you have less {h} than an opposing hero, it gets go again.
When this hits, gain 1{h}.

life_of_the_party.text_zh:
你可以弃置或摧毁你控制的一张名为疯狂酿造的牌，而非支付聚会中心人物的费用。若如此做，选择所有模式，否则随机选择其一；
此牌获得“当此牌命中时，获得2点生命。”
此牌获得+2力量。
此牌获得再动。
life_of_the_party.text_en:
You may discard or destroy a card you control named Crazy Brew rather than pay Life of the Party's {r} cost. If you do, choose all modes, otherwise choose 1 at random;

This gets "When this hits, gain life 2{h}."
This gets +2{p}.
This gets go again.

light_fingers.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，若你为盗贼，偷取攻击英雄控制的一个金币衍生物。
刃碎
light_fingers.text_en:
When this defends, if you are a Thief, steal a Gold token the attacking hero controls.
Blade Break

light_it_up.type_zh: 元素 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
light_it_up.text_zh:
莱克西专精
闪电融合
若点亮已融合，它获得“若此牌命中英雄，对其控制的每件装备各造成1点伤害。”
若点亮对英雄造成的伤害等于或大于其控制的装备数量，该英雄控制的装备直到其下一个回合结束失去且不能获得启动式异能。
light_it_up.text_en:
Lexi Specialization
Lightning Fusion
If Light it Up was fused, it gains "If this hits a hero, deal 1 damage to them for each equipment they control."
If Light it Up deals damage to a hero equal to or greater than the number of equipment they control, equipment they control lose and can't gain activated abilities until the end of their next turn.

light_of_sol.text_zh:
传奇
当此牌被资源时，展示你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为黄色，你可以将其置入你的英雄的灵魂。
light_of_sol.text_en:
Legendary
When this is pitched, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's yellow, you may put it into your hero's soul.

light_the_way.type_zh: 光 战士 行动·攻击
light_the_way.text_zh:
作为使用此牌的额外费用，你可以为你的英雄的灵魂充能。
当此牌命中时，若以此方式充能的是黄色牌，此牌获得再动。
light_the_way.text_en:
As an additional cost to play this, you may charge your hero's soul.
When this hits, if a yellow card was charged this way, this gets go again.

light_up_the_leaves.type_zh: 大地 法师 行动
light_up_the_leaves.text_zh:
对任意目标造成6点秘法伤害。
瞬间——弃掉此牌和一张大地牌：防止目标来源本回合将造成的接下来6点秘法伤害。
light_up_the_leaves.text_en:
Deal 6 arcane damage to any target.
Instant - Discard this and an Earth card: Prevent the next 6 arcane damage target source would deal this turn.

lighten_the_load.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以弃一张牌或摧毁你控制的一个物品。若如此做，此牌获得再动。
lighten_the_load.text_en: When this attacks, you may discard a card or destroy an item you control. If you do, this gets go again.

lightning_form.text_zh: 当此牌命中时，创造一个闪电化身衍生物。
lightning_form.text_en: When this hits, create an Embodiment of Lightning token.

lightning_greaves.text_zh:
瞬间——支付1点资源，摧毁此牌：本回合你使用的瞬间牌获得再动。
